element.reason: Round 2: the page column pads and stacks every body with no outer card (A3); the rail mark is a shadcn avatar that shows a fallback until the served SVG loads, so it never shows blank in light or dark (F4); one binary light/dark icon beside the account button in the sidebar footer (F1); every element is a Designer component inside the shell landmarks, so the frame passes the ds-only scan (NEED3).
